decided: When the user's setting lets the AI run an archive unasked, the one question it answers by itself is whether to copy the change's specification edits into the main specifications, taking the marked answer; every other question an archive or an implementation run can ask still stops and waits for the user.
alternatives: let the AI also answer the incomplete-tasks and unresolved-marker questions with their usual answer
stop at every question, the specification copy included
why: Copying the specifications is the step archiving exists for and sends nothing outside the project; the other questions either leave unfinished work behind or ask whether the change is in a sound state, which is the user's call.

relies_on.title: A chain treats each prompt by its kind
